title: This supernova impostor baffled astronomers for 15 years — until they found a hidden black hole feeding on an unstable star
caption:
Astronomers finally solved the mystery of AT 2016blu. This star has been 'crying wolf' for 15 years, but it’s actually a victim of a cosmic vampire.
